description: Synthetic labeled cases for demos and local regression only.

dashboard.title: Operations Control Tower
dashboard.description: Operational KPIs sourced from the daily warehouse load.

monitor_card.title: Operations data freshness
monitor_card.intent: Escalate when operational metrics cannot be trusted because the warehouse load is stale. Do not treat missing data as a normal metric decline.
investigation_hints: Check warehouse load freshness before interpreting KPI movement.
monitor_card.materiality_definition: The warehouse load is not trustworthy when freshness exceeds the daily operating window; missing current values must be escalated rather than interpreted.

outcome_guidance.investigate: Use when the evidence is incomplete but the freshness condition is not proven.
outcome_guidance.escalate: Use when the warehouse load is stale or current operational metrics cannot be trusted.
outcome_guidance.insufficient_data: Use when the source cannot provide the freshness evidence.

dashboard.title: Growth Funnel
dashboard.description: Acquisition and conversion performance by device.

monitor_card.title: Checkout conversion regression
monitor_card.intent: Notify growth when checkout conversion materially falls and the movement is concentrated in mobile. Inspect mobile checkout errors before routing.
investigation_hints: Confirm traffic is not the explanation.
monitor_card.materiality_definition: Treat the movement as material when checkout conversion falls at least 15%, the mobile dimension is materially worse than desktop, mobile errors rise sharply, and traffic is approximately stable.

outcome_guidance.investigate: Use when one of the required conversion, device, error, or traffic signals is missing or contradictory.
outcome_guidance.notify: Use when conversion, device concentration, related errors, and stable traffic support a Growth-owned issue.
outcome_guidance.escalate: Use only when the evidence indicates a severe incident requiring urgent intervention.

dashboard.title: Revenue Health
dashboard.description: Executive view of revenue quality and growth drivers.

monitor_card.title: Revenue deterioration
monitor_card.intent: Alert when revenue quality materially deteriorates. Compare revenue with enterprise churn, pipeline, and new customers. Ignore normal small movements. If enterprise churn explains the movement, notify revenue operations.
investigation_hints: Compare total revenue with enterprise churn.
Check whether pipeline moved with revenue.
monitor_card.materiality_definition: Treat the movement as material when revenue falls at least 10% and enterprise churn is a corroborating adverse signal; small pipeline or new-customer changes alone are not enough.

outcome_guidance.investigate: Use when revenue moves without a corroborating explanation or when source evidence is incomplete.
outcome_guidance.notify: Use when revenue deterioration is corroborated by enterprise churn and Revenue Operations owns the response.
outcome_guidance.escalate: Use only when the evidence indicates a severe business impact beyond routine Revenue Operations response.

dashboard.title: Retail Weekly Pulse
dashboard.description: Retail sales dashboard with a strong holiday pattern.

monitor_card.title: Retail sales pulse
monitor_card.intent: Alert only when retail sales move outside normal seasonal behavior. Use orders and the seasonality index before notifying retail operations.
investigation_hints: Check whether orders moved with sales.
Use the seasonality index before escalating.
monitor_card.materiality_definition: A sales decline is not material when sales and orders move together and the seasonality index remains within 0.05 of its baseline; otherwise route for review.

outcome_guidance.ignore: Use when sales and orders move together and the seasonality index is within the owner-defined normal range.
outcome_guidance.investigate: Use when the seasonal context is missing, outside the normal range, or contradictory.
outcome_guidance.notify: Use when the movement is outside normal seasonal behavior and Retail Operations should act.
